      "to": "TRANSACTION state"
    },

      "from": "TRANSACTION state",
      "event": "DELE msg",
      "action": "server marks the message as deleted or issues an error",
      "to": "TRANSACTION state"
    },
    {
      "from": "TRANSACTION state",
      "event": "NOOP",
      "action": "server replies with a positive response",
      "to": "TRANSACTION state"
    },
    {
      "from": "TRANSACTION state",
      "event": "RSET",
      "action": "server unmarks any messages marked as deleted and replies with a positive response",
      "to": "TRANSACTION state"
    },

      "from": "TRANSACTION state",
      "event": "QUIT",

      "to": "UPDATE state"
